purpose: Extend the bounded motion test across the training sequence before inspecting results
reference: Local visible-only FB component tracklets freshly seeded per window; never global object or material IDs
qualification: Exactly four components throughout the window, no FB merge ambiguity, every component has >=30 known reference pixels and >=95% single-label purity; all four seed labels present at every observation
tracker_inputs: Only first five component positions/areas/masks, then no observations until forecast scored before first reappearance observation
parameters: Same Config and three variants as initial bounded test, no tuning
interpretation: Artificial gaps in qualified visible tracklets, not real fully occluded identity accuracy. Qualification may bias to easier fragments; report every exclusion and per-stratum coverage.
inputs: Same frozen training images/components and raw forward/backward flow; ignore H3 motion/valid/depth fields
gate: Diagnostic only; no new full reconstruction training while persistent surface support or physical identity remains unverified
